answer: Because the timing is entered against the pulse challenge, the oasis audit can replay the inlet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 140 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3938 identities would post 2522 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
